slices.focus: Saira covers brother Imran's taxi licensing costs, prompting financial boundary decisions
slices.summary: Saira covers a few hundred pounds for brother Imran's taxi insurance/licensing issue and loses a Sunday to admin. She decides to set boundaries: complete paperwork in one batch before she reviews, and evidence of the real gap before providing financial help. She plans to protect the hallway order as non-negotiable.
